title: Multimodal Flow: A Unified Continuous Paradigm

beats.text: Why do we force AI to cut photos into small bits when the real world looks like one long, smooth stream of light to us?
beats.visual_focus: A split screen showing pixelated blocks on one side and a smooth, flowing fluid gradient on the other.

beats.text: Old models act like a paint-by-number set. They turn a soft, gold sunset into stiff, boxy shapes that lose all the grace of light.
beats.visual_focus: A hand painting a gradient that abruptly turns into stiff, numbered color blocks.

beats.text: This new model treats words and looks like a flowing stream. It lets them mix and blend together on one path to make true sense.
beats.visual_focus: Two distinct streams (text and image) merging into one thick, swirling golden ribbon.

motif_params.title: Flow Backbone Architecture
motif_params.sub: Merging Text and Visual Embedding Streams

beats.text: Think of it as a river guide. It shows the way, letting the brain parts map out colors and words at the same fast time.
beats.visual_focus: A central river branching into smaller specialized channels, each labeled 'Vision' or 'Text'.

beats.text: The result is a clear view of our world. It works much better than old tools while using way less data to learn its craft.
beats.visual_focus: A graph line shooting upward, surpassing a flatter, lower-performing baseline benchmark bar.
